in_greek.name: Νικόλη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Νικόλη προέρχεται από το ελληνικό όνομα Νικόλαος, που σημαίνει νίκη του λαού. Είναι ένα θηλυκό όνομα που προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'νίκη' που σημαίνει νίκη και 'λαός' που σημαίνει λαός. Το όνομα Νικόλη έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί από τους πρώτους Χριστιανούς και συνδέεται με την πνευματική νίκη.

historical_references.reference: Saint Nicole de Myre, also known as Saint Nicola of Myra, was a 4th-century bishop of Myra in Lycia, a province of the Roman Empire in Anatolia. She was renowned for her charitable deeds, which included secretly leaving gifts in children's shoes left out to dry, and for her protection of the innocent and the poor. She was especially venerated in Europe, and her feast day is celebrated on December 6.

Nicole Oresme, a 14th-century French philosopher, mathematician, theologian, and statesman, is best known for his work 'De Moneta', in which he analyzed the role of money in the economy. He was also a leading figure in the intellectual circles of King Charles V of France. He was born in Alençon, and died in Rouen.
